# ViraStack Address (full)

> `@virastack/address` (1.0.x): headless Turkish address hook for React. Chained province (il), district (ilçe) and neighbourhood (mahalle) selects, derived postal codes, server validation and the bundled PTT dataset. Zero runtime dependencies. Not a component: no markup, no styles.

## Install

```bash
npm install @virastack/address
# peer: react >= 18.2 (optional for the /server and /data entries)
```

Docs: https://virastack.com/address/docs; Index: https://virastack.com/address/llms.txt; Repo: https://github.com/virastack/form/tree/main/packages/address

## Entry points

| Import | Exports | Runs on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@virastack/address` | `useViraAddress`, `formatAddress` and the helpers | client (`"use client"`) |
| `@virastack/address/server` | `resolveAddress`, `resolvePostalCode`, `districtsOf`, `findProvince`, `formatAddress`, `normalizePostalCode` | server, no React |
| `@virastack/address/data` | `provinces`, `districts`, `neighbourhoods`, `findPostalCode`, `source`, `setLoader` | client + server, no React |

## Critical rules for agents

1. One hook: `useViraAddress`. Spread `getProvinceProps()`, `getDistrictProps()` and `getNeighbourhoodProps()` on the three selects.
2. Picking a level clears the levels below it. Do not clear them by hand.
3. The postal code is derived from the neighbourhood, never typed on its own. Use `getPostalCodeInputProps()` for a typed code that fills the selects.
4. With React Hook Form, pass `form` (`useForm()` or `useFormContext()`). Fields are `province`, `district`, `neighbourhood`, `postalCode`; rename with `names`. Add `provinceCode` to `names` only when the backend wants the plate code.
5. Always validate again on the server with `resolveAddress`. A client can post any postal code.
6. Province, district and neighbourhood values are the dataset's raw names (upper case Turkish); `label` is title-cased for display.
7. Rendering is yours: pass `as` to `getXProps()` for non-native selects.

## Quick start

```tsx
import { useViraAddress } from "@virastack/address";

function AddressFields() {
  const { getProvinceProps, getDistrictProps, getNeighbourhoodProps, value } = useViraAddress();

  return (
    <>
      <select {...getProvinceProps()} />
      <select {...getDistrictProps()} />
      <select {...getNeighbourhoodProps()} />
      <p>Posta kodu: {value.postalCode ?? "—"}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

`value`:

```ts
{
  provinceCode: "34",
  province: "İSTANBUL",
  district: "FATİH",
  neighbourhood: "AKSARAY MAH.",
  postalCode: "34096",
  postalCodes: ["34096"], // all codes, for the few hundred neighbourhoods with several
}
```

Every list is `{ value, label }`. The hook also returns the lists and setters (`provinces`, `setProvince`, ...), `reset()`, `error`, `loading.neighbourhoods`, `setPostalCode()`, `postalCodeStatus` and `getPostalCodeInputProps()`.

## Prop getters

Each getter returns a plain `<select>`'s props: options (empty first one as placeholder), `value`, `onChange`, `disabled`, `aria-busy`, `name`, `id`. The district waits for a province, the neighbourhood for a district and its data. Override any prop after the spread, or pass `{ placeholder }`.

| `as` | Output |
| --- | --- |
| `native` (default) | props for `<select>` |
| `headless` | `options`, `onChange(value)`, `loading`, `placeholder` for your own component |
| `antd` | `options`, `loading`, search where "istanbul" finds "İstanbul" |
| `shadcn` | `value`, `onValueChange`, `disabled` for `Select`; items are yours |

A district can hold hundreds of neighbourhoods (Yusufeli has 674), so use a searchable select there.

## Options

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | bundled dataset | swap for a fixture or your own endpoint |
| `defaultValue` | - | `{ provinceCode, district, neighbourhood }`; with `form`, read from the form when omitted |
| `formatLabel` | `formatName` | `(name) => name` keeps the dataset's upper case |
| `onChange` | - | called with the whole `value` on every change, not on first render |
| `form` | - | anything with `setValue(name, value, options)`; `getValues` to start filled, `subscribe` to follow `reset()` |
| `names` | `province`, `district`, `neighbourhood`, `postalCode` | field names in the form and on the inputs; `provinceCode` written only when named |
| `shouldValidate` | `true` | revalidate form fields as the address changes |

## React Hook Form

```tsx
const form = useForm<{ province: string; district: string; neighbourhood: string; postalCode: string }>();
const { getProvinceProps, getDistrictProps, getNeighbourhoodProps } = useViraAddress({ form });
```

Clearing a level clears it in the form with `shouldDirty`, `shouldTouch` and `shouldValidate`. Edit forms work as is: the hook starts from the address in the form's values and filling the postal code does not dirty the form. `form.reset(data)`, the `values` option and `setValue()` on a level move the selects (React Hook Form 7.55+ for `subscribe`). React Hook Form is never imported.

## From a postal code

```tsx
const { getPostalCodeInputProps, postalCodeStatus } = useViraAddress({ form });
<input {...getPostalCodeInputProps()} />
```

The input strips non-digits and looks up at five digits. Without the input call `setPostalCode("34710")`; `setPostalCode(null)` drops the lookup.

| `postalCodeStatus` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `exact` | one neighbourhood under the code: all three levels filled |
| `partial` | province and district filled; neighbourhoods narrowed to the code |
| `unknown` | not in the dataset; nothing changes, input gets `aria-invalid` |
| `loading` | the code's province is loading |

## Address line

```ts
formatAddress(value);                       // "Alandüzü Mah. Adapazarı/Sakarya"
formatAddress(value, { postalCode: true }); // "Alandüzü Mah. 54100 Adapazarı/Sakarya"
formatAddress(value, { separator: ", " });  // "Alandüzü Mah. Adapazarı, Sakarya"
```

Unpicked levels are left out. Also exported from `/server`.

## Server

```ts
import { resolveAddress, resolvePostalCode } from "@virastack/address/server";

const { ok, value, issues } = await resolveAddress({
  province: "istanbul", // name in any casing, or a plate code: 34, "34", "06"
  district: "fatih",
  neighbourhood: "aksaray mah.",
});
// !ok -> issues: [{ level: "district", reason: "unknown" }]
// value.postalCode is derived here, not trusted
```

A submitted `postalCode` is checked too: a code outside the neighbourhood's gives `{ level: "postalCode", reason: "mismatch" }`; with several codes, the one sent is kept.

`resolvePostalCode("34096")` returns `{ ok, value, issues, neighbourhoods }`: as much of the address as the code can say, plus candidate neighbourhoods. No `"use client"`, safe in Server Components and Server Actions.

## Data

```ts
import { provinces, districts, neighbourhoods, findPostalCode, source } from "@virastack/address/data";

provinces.length;                 // 81
districts(34);                    // ["ADALAR", "ARNAVUTKÖY", ...]
const byDistrict = await neighbourhoods(34);
byDistrict.get("FATİH");          // [{ name, postalCode, postalCodes }, ...]
await findPostalCode("34710");    // { postalCode, province, district, neighbourhoods }
source.date;                      // when the data was collected
```

81 provinces, 973 districts, 72,466 neighbourhoods (PTT, https://www.ptt.gov.tr/posta-kodu). Names and districts are bundled (about 5 kB gzip); each province's neighbourhoods load when picked (median 4.6 kB, p90 9.2 kB, largest 28.5 kB). A typical visit downloads about 10 kB. Verify against PTT for delivery-critical work. A data refresh is a patch release.

Custom loader: `setLoader(async (provinceCode) => fetch(`/api/address/${provinceCode}`).then((r) => r.text()))`.

## Helpers and types

`formatName`, `toSearchKey`, `compareNames`, `formatAddress`; all types are exported. Turkish-aware: sorting, case folding and title case respect `İ` and `ı`. Details: https://virastack.com/address/docs/helpers and https://virastack.com/address/docs/types
